instruction: I need you to convert OIP.jpg from /home/user into a PDF document and save it as 'invoice.pdf' in the Documents folder.

metadata.explanation: Task converts image to PDF and saves in Documents folder with different filename. Evaluator performs basic validation: (1) file exists at correct path, (2) has at least 1 page, (3) file size > 1KB indicating real content. Different location and filename test agent's ability to follow specific save instructions.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies file exists at the specified path (/home/user/Documents/invoice.pdf)
Metric function properly validates PDF is readable and has at least 1 page using pypdf.PdfReader
File size check (> 1KB) provides reasonable assurance of non-empty content
Getter (get_vm_file) correctly fetches the file from the VM to validate
Empty expected rules dict is acceptable since metric performs validation based on file properties, not comparison against expected values

Minor limitation: evaluator cannot verify that PDF actually contains the converted image content from OIP.jpg, only that a valid PDF was created - but this aligns with the 'basic validation' scope described in metadata
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider enhancing to verify PDF contains exactly 1 page (since converting a single image should produce 1-page PDF)
Could add image dimension or aspect ratio checks to confirm PDF contains image-like content
For more rigorous validation, could extract image from PDF and compare dimensions/properties with source OIP.jpg
